# OpenAI / ChatGPT + Codex changelog — captured 2026-08-09
# https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/changelog
# (sources.json still points at developers.openai.com/codex/changelog, a 308 cross-host redirect)

Newest entry is still **Codex CLI 0.147.0, August 7, 2026** — IDENTICAL to the 2026-08-07 capture.
No entries dated August 8 or 9.

0.147.0 (Aug 7, reported 2026-08-07): portable Agent Plugins with search across local, personal,
workspace and remote plugin catalogs; conversation sections and incremental transcript browsing;
`--approve-for-me` automatic approvals; import Cursor-managed skills and sync Claude/Cursor
conversations; MCP protocol 2026-07-28 (paginated discovery, multi-round requests, non-blocking
server startup); cached web search; remote conversation compaction for Amazon Bedrock.
0.146.1 (Aug 5, reported 2026-08-07): safer automatic-review defaults for cyber-capable models.

SDK releases — unchanged:
  openai-python v2.53.0 (Aug 3) "GPT-5.5 model support" + tool name/namespace fields on Response
  types; v2.52.x (Jul 31) content provenance checks, Retry-After handling, mTLS docs.
  openai-node v7.4.0 (Aug 3) same model/tool-metadata adds + mTLS transport examples; v7.3.0
  (Jul 31) content provenance checks; v7.2.0 (Jul 30) fast tier.
  NOTE (carried): SDK release-note wording mislabels model families — 5.6 shipped Jul 9 but the
  Aug 3 SDK entry says "GPT-5.5". Corroborate model launches against openai.com/index/*.

Status RSS (status.openai.com/history.rss): newest incidents Aug 4–5, 2026 (ChatGPT conversation
errors, Custom GPT actions, image generation). Incidents only — no new service or endpoint.

Community forum: Aug 9 threads on the completed GPT-5.6 rollout (billing/token-count anomalies),
Codex rate-limit resets, MCP tools being disabled mid-run, and **gpt-realtime-2.1** language drift
and WebRTC support. `gpt-realtime-2.1` / `-mini` remain **forum-only** — still absent from SDK
changelogs and platform docs. WATCH CONTINUES (open since ~2026-07-06).

Updated: 2026-08-09 — no change.
